title: Your Monitor’s Refresh Rate is Wrong

author: ThioJoe
description:
Many of you have your monitor set up wrong 👀

Apparently a lot of people don't realize that even after you get a high refresh rate monitor, you need to actually go into the settings to enable the higher refresh rate. Otherwise, Windows just defaults to standard 60 Hz as always. This leads to many people going a long time not even using the monitor feature they paid for, and in some cases for years.
